title: Spanish Review, Week of November 10: Breakfast, the Vet, and Clothes
intro: Welcome to your Spanish review for the week of November tenth. First, this week's new words. You'll hear the English, then a pause. Say the Spanish out loud, then listen to it twice. After that, a quick verb drill, a short recap of last week, and a conversation that uses what you've learned. Let's start.

sections.name: Breakfast.
items: vanilla syrup. There are two ways to say it.
el jarabe de vainilla. O, el sirope de vainilla.

sections.name: Health and the body.
items: weak. One, then more than one.

sections.name: People and expressions.
items: one or two. A few, here and there.

sections.name: Clothes.
items: dressed. For a man, then for a woman.

sections.name: Verbs and grammar.
items: I told him. Or, I told her.

drills.name: Verb drill. Decir, to say. Present tense.

recap.name: Now a quick recap from last week.

conversation.intro: Now, a conversation. Sofía and Diego are catching up. First you'll hear it slowly, with English after each line.
lines: Buenos días, Diego. ¿Qué comiste hoy en la mañana?
Good morning, Diego. What did you eat this morning?
Comí avena con jarabe de vainilla. ¿Y tú?
I ate oatmeal with vanilla syrup. And you?
Yo comí dos huevos y tomé café.
I ate two eggs and had coffee.
Más o menos. Ayer fui al veterinario con él.
So-so. Yesterday I went to the vet with him.
Tiene mal aliento y le duele un diente.
He has bad breath and one of his teeth hurts.
Poor little guy. He's a German shepherd, right?
Sí. Lo encontré en un refugio de animales.
Yes. I found him at an animal shelter.
And what did the vet tell you?
Me dijo que está un poco débil, y que tiene las uñas muy largas.
She told me he's a little weak, and that his nails are very long.
Is he in a lot of pain?
No, solo uno que otro día.
No, only a day here and there.
Mi abuelo también fue al doctor. Tiene el colesterol alto.
My grandfather also went to the doctor. He has high cholesterol.
Come muchos huevos, pero le echa la culpa a mi abuela.
He eats a lot of eggs, but he blames my grandmother.
Oye, me gusta tu suéter. ¿Es nuevo?
Hey, I like your sweater. Is it new?
Gracias. Sí. También compré una playera, y un collar para el perro.
Thanks. Yes. I also bought a T-shirt, and a collar for the dog.
No. Los vestidos no tienen bolsillos.
Bueno, ya estás vestida para el invierno. Y yo te digo algo: me gustas.
Well, now you're dressed for winter. And I'll tell you something: I like you.

outro: That's it for this week. Nice work. Hasta la próxima.
